core_traits.srd_text: Initialize a new Barbarian's first-level numerical character statistics. Starting Hit Points and unarmored Armor Class use the already adopted ability scores. Set level one, zero experience, proficiency and source-backed first-level class resource amounts. This action does not choose class identity, grant equipment or advance an experienced character.
